messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: realtime-streaming.p95 and p99 alert for eu-central-1 at 02:14 UTC — p95 jumped ~85ms -> 310ms, p99 ~1.6s. Auto-page to oncall.
Priya Shah: acknowledged, I'm oncall. Pulling up metric windows and recent feature flags.
Ethan Brooks: I'm joining, grabbing logs and the tracer. Sending grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/realtime/streaming?var-region=eu-central-1
Marina Lopez: support reported an uptick of stream disconnects and some customers seeing partial transcripts. Not a full outage but customer-impacting. Ticket queue ++.
Priya Shah: quick scope runbook: 1) region (eu-central-1) 2) routes (/v1/stream) 3) models: rdl-4-small / rdl-4-small-q4 4) traffic pattern: sudden spike in average request token-length from ~80 -> ~900 in last 10m.
Ethan Brooks: that token-length increase is suspicious. I'm tailing ingress and decoder logs:
```
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=stream-ingress --since=15m | grep -E "length|warn|error" -n
```
Ethan Brooks: sample from ingress: `[02:09:11] INFO ingress.go: request len=912 client=34.56.78.90 route=/v1/stream` repeated many times from same client IPs.
Devon Park: ops-bot: any infra events?
ops-bot: No scheduled infra changes in last 60m. Autoscaler at healthy target 12 pods, avg CPU 72%. Network error budget clear.
Marina Lopez: any deploys? deploy-bot: `deploy-bot history --since=40m` returns a config rollout for feature `encoder-v2` gated to 20% in eu-central-1 at 01:58 UTC.
Priya Shah: encoder-v2 at 20% could explain longer tokenization or encoding time per request. But token-length jump suggests a client-side bug generating huge prompts. Two possible amplifiers: encoder CPU overhead + long sequences => queueing -> p99 tails.
Ethan Brooks: instrument traces show encoder-v2 requests have median encode time 30ms -> 300ms under long sequences, and backpressure at the streamer input queue. Paste snippet: 
```
TRACE: req=abc123 stage=encode duration=312ms queue_len=58
TRACE: req=abc124 stage=model_exec duration=120ms
```
Priya Shah: mitigation options: A) rollback encoder-v2 flag to previous encoder for region; B) enforce max_input_tokens at router (short-term reject/400 or truncate); C) divert traffic for streaming to dedicated pool with larger CPU.
Devon Park: we can flip the flag quickly with `ffctl` or change traffic split. Which do we prefer? Immediate rollback is fastest.
Priya Shah: agreed. I'll rollback encoder-v2 in eu-central-1 to 0% now. Command: `ffctl set eu-central-1 encoder-v2 0% --author=Priya`
incident-bot: :hourglass_flowing_sand: Action recorded: encoder-v2 rollback 20% -> 0% by Priya Shah at 02:19:25 UTC.
Ethan Brooks: watching grafana. p95 started trending down within 90s, from 310ms -> 150ms. p99 still elevated ~820ms but improving.
Marina Lopez: meanwhile support reports some retries caused duplicate partial transcripts. Sending communication: "We observed elevated streaming latency and partial transcripts in eu-central-1; mitigation in progress, more updates in 30m."
Priya Shah: while rollback helps, we should also hard-limit request token length at the ingress to prevent repeated client floods. Propose temporary router rule: max_tokens=512 truncate=truncate (or reject for enterprise).
Devon Park: applying router rule: `routerctl set-rule --route /v1/stream --region eu-central-1 --max-tokens 512 --action truncate` at 02:21:10 UTC
ops-bot: Router rule applied by Devon Park at 02:21:10 UTC.
Ethan Brooks: subsequent traces show drop in encode duration for new requests, queue_len down to <10. p95 at 95ms, p99 at 400ms and falling.
Priya Shah: creating incident INC-2026-058 for follow-up. I'll add owners: Priya (oncall + RCA), Ethan (traces & perf), Marina (customer comms), Devon (router safeguards).
Marina Lopez: customers impacted: finance-team, partner-gamma, several trial accounts. Notifying account managers.
Ethan Brooks: follow-ups for RCA: 1) why encoder-v2 interacts poorly with long sequences (profiling needed), 2) why rollout didn't trigger smoke checks on median encode time, 3) add preflight gating by sample encode latencies and token-length distribution.
Priya Shah: action items: - add a preflight check that cancels rollouts if median encode time increases >2x for sampled traffic - enforce router-level max_token soft-limit for streaming by default - create an alert for sudden median token-length increases (similar to p95 latency alerts)
Devon Park: I'll file infra task to add token-length metric to the router metrics and hook to alerting.
Marina Lopez: posting status page note at 02:30 UTC and sending follow-up customer note at 02:35 UTC.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigations recorded: encoder-v2 rollback, router max_tokens enforced. Incident created: INC-2026-058 (streaming-latency-eu-central).
Ethan Brooks: saving trace bundles and logs to s3://incidents/INC-2026-058/ and will attach to ticket.
Priya Shah: handing back to rotation at 02:40 UTC. If p99 climbs above 1s again, page SRE and escalate.
Marina Lopez: closing live mitigation updates, will coordinate postmortem and customer timeline. Thanks all :pray:
